title: Download limits
label: Daily downloads per IP
hint: The same limit applies separately to each IP and resets at midnight Beijing time. Leave blank for unlimited; 0 blocks downloads. Only complete server transfers count. Active downloads reserve a slot; cancellation or failure releases it. Previews do not count.
failed: Unable to load or save. Please retry.
invalid: Enter an integer from 0 to 1000000, or leave blank for unlimited.
exceeded: Daily download limit reached. Please try again tomorrow.
unavailable: Download quota is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
